_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots (total_pop, audience_a) over region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_REF matrix-shape compose overlay that scores each audience_a cell against the matching total_pop cell (100 * audience_a / total_pop). First Compose-host matrix example in the catalog (E7-S9 MATRIX arm). Slot labels resolve via Request.Label after the E7-S1 auto-default — Reference names the baseline slot (the total population crosstab), Targets names the slot whose cells the overlay decorates. The compose chassis runs four sequential gates before the per-kind handler dispatches: slot label resolution (PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_UNKNOWN), key alignment (PULSE_OVERLAY_KEY_SET_DIVERGENT), schema match (PULSE_OVERLAY_SCHEMA_DIVERGENT), and optional dict-prefix drift (PULSE_OVERLAY_DICT_PREFIX_DRIFT, only when Options.DictPrefixFast=true). Both crosstabs read the same experiment.pulse cohort but differ via the Filterers slot — Filterers can carve out the audience subset without changing the matrix shape, so the key sets align by construction. Zero ref_cell emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO with NaN substitution; missing reference cells emit the same code with ref_missing=true and the overlay cell stays absent. Inherently buffered because the matrix arm runs through the Compose slot barrier (per the OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_REF dual-shape convention).
